summary: first party theme with a theme.json manifest of css variables and terminal colours, a canvas swirl effect (effects.js on top of the effects-base.js harness) and a pixel mascot svg. the scripts do no network access, storage or cookie reads, eval or Function, and the only import is the sibling effects-base.js. nothing is addressed to an agent or reviewer. the two webp images were not shown, which is expected for a theme and is not a finding on its own.
